text: Given a mocked form definition with a client_org dropdown question whose choices each carry tenantId/haloClientId/rewstOrgId, When mspbots_forms_form_get(form_id, field_id="client_org") is called, Then the returned JSON's choices array has every choice with all three properties present and no truncated flag set.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_field_id_returns_full_choice_metadata -v -> 1 passed in 1.03s. Test asserts response choices all carry tenantId/haloClientId/rewstOrgId, no truncated key, and that include=definition was forced upstream even though the caller passed no include.

text: Given a mocked question whose choices list alone would serialize past the 20,000-char budget, When the same filtered call is made, Then the response is valid JSON with truncated: true, an original_count, and every choice present in the truncated list has all of its own properties intact.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_field_id_truncates_oversized_choices_gracefully -v -> 1 passed in 1.03s. Test uses 300 synthetic choices (comfortably over the 20,000-char cap) and asserts truncated=true, original_count=300, 0 < len(choices) < 300, every surviving choice still has all 3 properties, and the serialized payload is <= 20,000 chars.

text: Given a field_id that matches no question in the mocked definition, When the filtered call is made, Then the response is an error envelope with code not_found naming the requested field_id and form_id.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_field_id_not_found_returns_structured_error -v -> 1 passed in 1.03s. Test asserts error.code == "not_found", error.retryable == false, and the message names both the requested field_id and form_id.

text: Given the exact same mocked backend response used by this repo's existing mspbots_forms_form_get tests, When the tool is called with no field_id, Then the output is unchanged from before this change.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_without_field_id_is_unchanged -v -> 1 passed in 1.03s. Test asserts the decoded payload equals the mocked backend response byte-for-byte and that the include param reaching the backend is exactly what the caller passed ("versions"), confirming field_id never forces include=definition when omitted.

text: Given the real offboarding form f7528a78 v4 in the MSPbots demo tenant, When an operator with PROD/INT MCP access calls the shipped mspbots_forms_form_get(form_id="f7528a78", field_id="client_org"), Then every real client_org option in the response retains its real tenantId, haloClientId, and rewstOrgId values.
steps: Obtain PROD or INT MCP access with a valid API key + tenant for the MSPbots demo tenant
Call mspbots_forms_form_get(form_id="f7528a78", field_id="client_org") against the shipped build
expect: Every client_org choice object includes non-empty tenantId, haloClientId, and rewstOrgId values matching the known mapping for that tenant; no truncated flag unless the real choice count genuinely exceeds the budget (in which case AC2's graceful-truncation behavior applies, not data loss)
evidence: Not executed: this sandbox has no network path to a live PROD/INT MCP deployment or real tenant credentials (consistent with this pipeline's standing constraint that dev-leg sandboxes cannot reach live backend services). Recorded as a local blind spot, not a pass -- requires an operator with PROD/INT access to run post-ship, per the design doc's own Test strategy section.

text: Given the new field_id code path, a code-level test confirms find_question_by_name is a pure function with no shared mutable state, and that the field_id branch uses the same per-request client_factory()/FormsAPIClient as every other branch.
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_form_get_field_id_path_introduces_no_shared_state -v -> 1 passed in 1.03s. Test (a) inspects _survey_walk module globals to confirm no mutable module-level state, (b) calls find_question_by_name twice with different definitions and confirms no cross-call leakage, and (c) drives two different tenants through the same field_id branch via the real per-request client_factory/contextvar path and confirms tenant-A's form data never leaks into tenant-B's response.
